The Chinese characters for Alexandra

As a transliteration, Alexandra is usually written 亚历山德拉 (Yà lì shān dé lā). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

亚
Yà
Asia, second
历
lì
experience, calendar
山
shān
mountain
德
dé
virtue, morality
拉
lā
pull

Origin and meaning

Alexandra comes from Greek and means “defender of the people”.

About the name Alexandra

The feminine of Alexander, carried by the last tsarina of Russia.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “defender of the people”, an Alexandra calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
